arguments.query: select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select group_concat(state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) k from bookings b
select * from charges where booking_id in (select booking_id from bookings where status="pending")
select event_id,status,attempts,substr(payload,1,60) p from outbox where status!="delivered"

select (select count(*) from bookings where status="pending") p,(select count(*) from outbox where status="pending") o,(select count(*) from bookings where status="confirmed") c,(select count(*) from checkins) k
select rowid,path,status,message from request_logs where status>=400 order by rowid desc limit 12

select b.booking_id,b.status,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select group_concat(state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) k,(select group_concat(status) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id) o from bookings b where b.status="pending" or h=0 and b.status="confirmed" or k=0 and b.status="confirmed" or o is null or o not like "delivered"
select rowid,path,status,duration_ms,message from request_logs where status>=400 and message not like "%sold out%" order by rowid desc limit 8
select rowid,path,status,message from request_logs where rowid>(select max(rowid)-25 from request_logs)

select 1 x, b.booking_id,b.status, b.amount_cents, b.client_reference, (select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and state="captured") cap,(select group_concat(amount_cents) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) amts,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) k from bookings b where b.rowid>(select max(rowid)-14 from bookings)
